question: Where does the breath-filled vital air abide within living beings?
premises: The vital air is described as filled with breath
It is said to be situated
Its location is in all living beings
inference: The breath-filled vital air abides in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam may reflect transmitted phrasing.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
